dashboard_trackers.name: IRAN NUCLEAR
dashboard_trackers.notes: No new IAEA or Iranian correction followed the reported suspension of inspectors, declarations and agency access. IAEA public pages remained HTTP 403/challenge-blocked, while fresh results concerned Saudi civilian nuclear policy or older Iran material. The exact NPT-withdrawal market rose to 15.0%, a sanity check only. Raw 56; coupled 64

dashboard_trackers.name: IRAN WAR
dashboard_trackers.notes: Reuters, carried in a direct OilPrice read, reports that a senior Iranian official rejected Oman's proposal to divide Strait of Hormuz lane control evenly and said Tehran wants all inbound plus part of outbound traffic under Iranian control. This crosses the configured refusal threshold, while nonzero traffic and the absence of independently verified tanker damage still argue against literal full closure. Brent was $90.55 at the 18Z vendor snapshot. Raw 100; coupled 100

dashboard_trackers.name: ISRAEL-LEBANON
dashboard_trackers.notes: Ynet reported at 17:01Z that the IDF is weighing strikes on Hezbollah tunnels after the bulldozer drone incident, but no Israeli response or casualty was verified. A second carrying source repeated a report that Israel wants no further withdrawal and freedom of action in talks; the underlying claim remains insufficient to score a separate refusal threshold. Raw 90; coupled 100

dashboard_trackers.name: TURKEY-NATO
dashboard_trackers.notes: The 18Z Google, Bing and NATO review found no verified Turkish combat entry, unusual force concentration, qualifying long-range weapons event or official strategic-weapons threshold. Raw 5; coupled 5

dashboard_trackers.name: INDIA-PAKISTAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: The exact rolling-day review found no fresh India-Pakistan interstate strike, Line of Control exchange or unusual mobilization. The earlier Uri mine blast remains without Pakistani attribution. Raw 15; coupled 15

dashboard_trackers.name: PAKISTAN-AFGHANISTAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: The rolling-day review added no fresh interstate strike, retaliation, crossing closure or operational follow-up beyond the UN-linked cumulative civilian toll. Raw 46; coupled 46

dashboard_trackers.name: RUSSIA-UKRAINE
dashboard_trackers.notes: Both exact Google and Bing rolling-day lanes remained empty, and the allied review found no direct NATO combat entry, fresh nuclear threshold or executed strategic retaliation. Raw 99; coupled 99

dashboard_trackers.notes: Taiwan's blockade-resilience drills and Chinese maritime patrol reporting remain posture signals, but no new blockade, expanded live-fire operation, amphibious concentration or direct clash was verified. Raw 24; coupled 28

dashboard_trackers.name: DPRK

dashboard_trackers.name: SUDAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: The refresh returned reporting on SAF road gains dated 27-28 July and the existing RSF pressure around El Obeid, but no post-15Z strategic capture, external intervention or verified force shift. Raw 94; coupled 94

dashboard_trackers.notes: UN News/OHCHR says settler violence and settlement creation are at an all-time high: 76 Palestinians and one Israeli had died in settler attacks by 24 July, with roughly 190 attacks per month in the first four months of 2026. This hardens the already capped lane; no separate post-15Z Gaza event or negotiation threshold was verified. Raw 100; coupled 100

dashboard_trackers.name: SOUTH SUDAN ABYEI
dashboard_trackers.notes: Direct UN, Google and Bing checks produced no new South Sudan-Abyei clash, verified large force movement, transition breakdown or UNISFA posture change. Raw 19; coupled 19

dashboard_trackers.name: EASTERN DRC
dashboard_trackers.notes: The 18Z Google, Bing and UN review added no current M23 territorial capture, direct Rwanda-DRC clash, mass recruitment order or verified strategic attack. The fresh UN DR Congo item was about Ebola, not conflict escalation. Raw 56; coupled 56

dashboard_trackers.name: YEMEN RED SEA
dashboard_trackers.notes: The claimed Houthi strike on tanker NCC GHAZAL remains unverified beyond the movement's statement; OilPrice says the vessel had already gone AIS-dark. Reuters reporting on possible shipping fees and China-Houthi passage talks persists, while indexed traffic data said Bab el-Mandeb transits were at a one-week high. No new verified damage or general navigation restoration appeared. Raw 95; coupled 95

dashboard_trackers.name: KUWAIT IRAQ BORDER
